command: ssh nas 'docker ps --format "{{.Names}}" | grep collega; docker exec collega-db-1 psql -U postgres -d collega -c "select c.college_ref, c.status, count(i.id) items, count(nullif(i.chapter_title,\x27\x27)) titled from colleges c left join items i on i.college_id=c.id group by c.college_ref, c.status order by 1;"' 2>&1 | head -40
